whoItsFor: Developers and power users of AI coding agents (especially Claude Code, plus Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, and others) who want their agent to remember context across sessions without re-explaining their project each time.
useCases: Carry project context and decisions from one Claude Code session into the next automatically
Search past agent sessions with natural-language queries via MCP search tools
Back up or sync agent memory to cmem.ai across machines
